virtualKeySheet.createDescription: Create a new virtual key with specific permissions, budgets, and rate limits.
virtualKeySheet.editDescription: Update the virtual key configuration and permissions.
virtualKeySheet.managedByProfile: This virtual key is managed by an access profile. Only the name and description can be modified; providers, budgets, rate limits, and MCP access are controlled by the profile.
virtualKeySheet.providerConfigTooltip: Configure which providers this virtual key can use and their specific settings. Leave empty to block all providers. Add providers to allow them.
virtualKeySheet.mcpConfigTooltip: Configure which MCP clients this virtual key can use and their allowed tools. Leaving this section empty blocks all MCP tools. After adding an MCP client, you must select specific tools or choose Allow All Tools to grant tool access.
virtualKeySheet.selectMCPPlaceholder: Select an MCP client to add
virtualKeySheet.allowAllToolsDesc: Allow all current and future tools
virtualKeySheet.defaultMCPClients: The following MCP servers are available to this key by default with all tools enabled on that client: {{names}}. Adding an explicit config for any of them below will override the all-tools default for this key.
virtualKeySheet.budgetOverrideDesc: Add temporary capacity without changing the configured base budgets above.
virtualKeySheet.calendarAlignDesc: Reset budgets and rate limits at the start of each period (e.g. 1st of month) instead of rolling from creation date. Applies to durations of a day or longer.
virtualKeySheet.calendarAlignWarningDesc: Enabling calendar alignment will reset budget usage to $0.00 and token/request rate-limit counters to 0 for this virtual key, then snap each reset date to the start of its current period (e.g. start of day, week, month, or year). The usage reset cannot be undone, but calendar alignment can be turned off later. This will take effect when you save.
virtualKeySheet.rotateDesc: This will replace the secret value for "{{name}}". The key ID, budgets, rate limits, provider permissions, MCP access, and assignments stay the same. The previous key value will stop working immediately.
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetQuarterShiftTitle: Carry usage into the new quarter?
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetDesc: You changed a budget amount, reset frequency, or calendar alignment. Reset current budget usage to 0, or preserve the existing usage counters.
virtualKeySheet.budgetResetWarningSuffix: You can preserve usage anyway, or reset usage to 0.
virtualKeySheet.noPermission: You don't have permission to perform this action

budgetOverride.description: Temporarily add spending capacity without changing the base {{amount}} budget.
budgetOverride.forCycles: For a number of reset cycles
budgetOverride.firstCycleNote: The current reset cycle counts as the first cycle.

multiBudget.duplicateDuration: Duplicate reset period; each budget line must use a different interval.

budgetWarning.overLimit: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget has {{usage}} usage, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.
budgetWarning.quarterShift: {{scope}} quarterly budget has {{usage}} of usage. Changing the fiscal quarter moves the reset date and carries that spend into the new quarter.
budgetWarning.overLimitInherited: {{scope}} {{duration}} budget will inherit {{usage}} from the {{sourceDuration}} budget, which meets or exceeds the new {{limit}} limit.
